title: Kenworth T610 SAR FUPS Hi-tensile Aluminium Road Train Bullbar #52
description: Kenworth T610 SAR FUPS compliant polished Road Train hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar. Extended deep heavy duty reinforced main channel with flush mounted box uprights to allow for minimum front overhang. 76mm pipe with an additional mid mounted pipe in front of the grille for maximum protection and a full width cross pipe above headlights. All cross pipes are recessed into the drilled uprights, no butt welds. The heavy duty box uprights are 6mm wall high tensile aluminium for maximum strength and protection. There are two 12mm heavy duty flat plates welded to the top of the main channel which tie the three cross pipes back to the main channel for max. protection. Flip over aluminium combination Road Train/ Long Vehicle signs plus dual Dangerous Goods signs mounted on secure plates welded to the uprights. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Main bumper channel with heavy duty return panel to match mudguard contour, heavy duty clear perspex is fitted to the outer section of the bull bar to protect the headlights. The centre bar is a custom made extrusion that will mount a light bar plus there are two driving light mounting plates on the rear section of the top pipe outside the each uptight. LED Indicator/daylight running/park light combination lights are mounted in the outer box uprights.
